http/proxy_policy#

An HTTP proxy and its credentials.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

ProxyPolicy(ParsedUrl("http://proxy.internal:3128").parts());
ProxyPolicy(origin: url, credentials: BasicCredentials(username: "ann", password: secret));

Description#

An HTTP proxy and its credentials.

The proxy is spoken to in plain HTTP; https origins are still verified through the tunnel.

Public API#

object ProxyPolicy#

object ProxyPolicy

Explicit plain HTTP proxy. Origin HTTPS is verified after CONNECT; TLS to the proxy itself needs a separate nested transport and is not inferred.

ProxyPolicy.ProxyPolicy#

ProxyPolicy(origin is UrlParts)

The proxy at origin: an http URL with no userinfo, path, query or fragment; InvalidProxy otherwise.

ProxyPolicy.ProxyPolicy#

ProxyPolicy(origin is UrlParts, credentials is BasicCredentials)

The same, sending credentials with Proxy-Authorization.

ProxyPolicy.url#

url() is UrlParts

Its URL.

ProxyPolicy.authenticated#

authenticated() is bool

Whether it has credentials.

ProxyPolicy.credentials#

credentials() is BasicCredentials

The credentials; MissingProxyCredentials when there are none.
